summary: Create a live Map iterator yielding fresh two-element [key,value] Arrays in insertion order.

semantics.yield_shape: new two-element Array for each visited entry

tests.name: entry pairs
tests.input: const m=new Map([['a',1]]); const e=m.entries().next().value; console.log(e[0],e[1],Array.isArray(e));

tests.name: new entry added during iteration is visited
tests.input: const m=new Map([['a',1]]); const it=m.entries(); console.log(it.next().value[0]); m.set('b',2); console.log(it.next().value[0]);
